method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks end lower as worries over oil prices, interest rates give investors pause
Equities.reason: Broad-market risk sentiment turned negative as rising oil prices and interest-rate concerns weighed on equities. This is a market-regime signal (geopolitical-driven oil risk + rates) rather than single-stock noise, so relevance is high and the net effect is bearish for equities.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Middle East deadlock
Equities.reason: Reuters market note highlights Middle East/Hormuz geopolitical stalemate lifting oil risk premia and increasing market volatility — a negative macro impulse for global equity risk appetite and liquidity conditions.

Equities.title: Nvidia teams up with Wall Street asset managers on $500 billion AI infrastructure push
Equities.reason: Major coordinated financing to back AI infrastructure reinforces the dominant positive equity narrative around AI leadership and large-cap tech leadership, supporting risk appetite and tech sector multiple expansion.

Equities.title: Taiwan, South Korea drive Asian equity outflows in July as AI worries bite
Equities.reason: Fund-flow signal showing AI-related investor concern and outflows from semiconductor-heavy markets — a negative regional equity impulse that can amplify downside in global tech-centric indices.

Rates.title: Treasury yields up as oil prices jump and investors await inflation data
Rates.summary: U.S. Treasury yields edged higher Tuesday as investors await July's inflation data print amid ongoing Iran tensions.
Rates.reason: Direct report of U.S. Treasury yields rising driven by oil/geopolitical risk and CPI anticipation — clear negative for bond prices (yields up). Relatively high relevance for the Rates narrative.

Rates.title: Fed’s Hammack Says ‘Some Number’ of Rate Hikes May Be Needed
Rates.reason: Fed official signalling additional rate hikes is a strong hawkish signal that raises policy-rate risk and pushes yields higher — high relevance for the Rates regime (higher-for-longer).

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Dovish repricing on data and inflation focus – BNY
Rates.summary: John Velis at BNY Markets reiterates that he expects no Federal Reserve rate hikes this year, even as risks remain skewed to the upside.
Rates.reason: Market call for dovish repricing (expectation of no hikes) is supportive for bonds (yields lower) but is a counter-signal to prevailing hawkish headlines — moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Wall St futures muted amid fading Hormuz deal hopes; CPI awaited
Rates.reason: Geopolitical uncertainty (Hormuz) plus CPI event risk dampens risk appetite and lifts safe-rate compensation — tends to push Treasury yields up; relevant for intraday rates moves.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Long bond bother
Rates.reason: Market commentary flagging weakness in long-duration bonds — consistent with a regime of rising yields/term-premium; relevant market-structure signal for Rates.

Rates.title: Interest rates may stay higher for longer. What that means for consumers
Rates.summary: Any move toward higher rates would increase borrowing costs for consumers at a time when affordability pressures are already mounting.
Rates.reason: Macro narrative piece reinforcing the higher-for-longer regime — negative for bond prices as it implies sustained elevated yields; modestly relevant to rates outlook.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ research explicitly on reduced JGB purchases — reduction in central-bank demand tends to put upward pressure on JGB yields and affects global rates sentiment; directly relevant to sovereign bond markets.

Rates.title: Colombia Inflation Unexpectedly Slows, Easing Pressure on Rates
Rates.reason: Slower inflation in Colombia reduces local central-bank tightening pressure, supportive for local bond prices (yields down). EM rates-specific, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: These Bonds Offer a Rare Buying Opportunity
Rates.reason: Market-strategy piece suggesting attractive valuations in bonds — constructive for demand/flows into fixed income but primarily a tactical/technical view so lower relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Supported by rising Oil prices
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) extends its Monday recovery move on Tuesday, as rising Oil prices due to prolonged fears of energy supply disruption keep global inflation expectations de-anchored.
FX.reason: DXY/USD-strength narrative: rising oil and renewed inflation risk supporting the USD. Broad DXY-focused piece with market-inflation transmission makes it an important USD-positive driver.

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as market caution lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8110 during the early European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair has pushed higher as the US Dollar (USD) erased its intraday losses, fueled by a sharp rally in crude oil driven by hei
FX.reason: Pair-level confirmation of USD strength (safe-haven / oil-driven flows) versus CHF. Useful signal but more idiosyncratic than broad DXY commentary.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Yield outlook fails to lift Yen – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale strategists note the Japanese Yen (JPY) remains the main G10 laggard despite higher domestic yields and Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening.
FX.reason: JPY-specific narrative: Yen remains weak despite tighter BoJ outlook, reinforcing USD/JPY upside and broader dollar resilience. High relevance given JPY's market impact.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening key to recovery against US Dollar - OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that Japan’s recent FX intervention, backed by United States (US) involvement, has not fully reversed Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness, with USD/JPY near 159 after retracing much of its post-intervention drop.
FX.reason: Intervention thread but incomplete recovery: reinforces dominant USD/JPY weakness theme and systemic USD strength risk. High relevance due to intervention element and US involvement.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar declines as US Dollar rebounds on safe-haven demand
FX.summary: NZD/USD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.5880 during the European hours on Tuesday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains on increased safe-haven demand amid heightened geopolitical tensions.
FX.reason: NZD/USD moves driven by USD safe-haven rebound amid geopolitical risk; clear USD-positive transmission but a more localized pair move, so moderate relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar remains near two-month highs against US Dollar as Oil prices rise
FX.summary: USD/CAD trades around 1.3935 on Tuesday at the time of writing, virtually unchanged on the day with a modest 0.03% decline.
FX.reason: CAD outperformance vs USD linked to higher oil — a local counter-flow to headline USD strength. Relevant due to oil-USD/CAD transmission but pair-specific.

FX.title: Australian Dollar edges up, RBA hawkish hold does little to revive rate hike expectations
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) attracts bids against its major currency peers after the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) monetary policy decision, but is still trading marginally lower at around 0.7050 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading sess
FX.reason: AUD bid versus USD after RBA decision but with muted rate-hike expectations; small positive for AUD/USD but limited market impact.

FX.title: US Dollar: Volatility sinks as carry trades hold – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that FX volatility is falling as investors appear comfortable with the Federal Reserve holding or potentially tightening rates in September.
FX.reason: Lower FX volatility and expectations of Fed holding/tightening support the USD and reduce cross-currency moves. Important for medium-term dollar positioning.

FX.title: British Pound: Upside tests but capped near 1.3555 against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that GBP/USD extended last week’s rally, but overbought conditions should confine intraday moves to a 1.3490–1.3535 band.
FX.reason: GBP/USD technical/positioning note: indicates some sterling resilience versus USD but largely tactical and capped — limited macro relevance.

FX.title: Yuan’s March Against Dollar May Resume Next Month, Analysts Say
FX.reason: Headline suggests potential CNY appreciation versus USD (resumption of 'march' against dollar). China FX moves are globally relevant; however summary lacks detail so assigned moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold Price Forecast: Rally hits pause near $4,440 with US CPI in focus
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades 0.26% lower at around $4,380 during the European trading session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece noting a pause in the rally and near-term retracement into US CPI — short-term negative for gold. Forecast/technical stories get capped relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold rises for third straight session, inflation prints in focus
Commodities.reason: Wire report indicating multi-session gains as markets focus on inflation data — macro-driven bullish for gold (inflation/real-rate hedge), higher relevance than a pure technical note.

Commodities.title: Gold Climbs Above $4,400 as Traders Turn Focus to US Inflation
Commodities.reason: Newswire (Bloomberg) showing price breakout above $4,400 tied to inflation focus — supports the prevailing bullish inflation/flight-to-safety narrative for gold.

Commodities.title: Gold retreats further from two-month high, eyes $4,350 as Fed rate hike bets support USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its intraday retracement slide from the highest level since June 5 and drops to a fresh daily low, near the $4,350 area during the first half of the European session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Technical intraday retracement tied to stronger USD / Fed-hike expectations — a near-term bearish counter-signal to the inflation-driven gold rally; technical relevance capped.

Commodities.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
Commodities.summary: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $64.78 per troy ounce, down 2.72% from the $66.59 it cost on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Direct price drop in silver (significant intraday move). Silver often amplifies gold moves; this is a market-relevant negative for silver demand/price in the near term.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD corrects lower from $67.00 resistance area
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades lower on Tuesday, retreating to levels below $64.50, after rejection at seven-week highs around $66.60 on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Technical/forecast piece describing a corrective move from resistance — short-term negative but limited relevance under the technical cap.

Commodities.title: Brent: Inflation risks rise with Hormuz standoff – Deutsche Bank
Commodities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that Brent Oil has broken above $85, closing near $88 as the Strait of Hormuz remains shut and rhetoric between the US and Iran escalates.
Commodities.reason: Strategists flag a clear supply-risk (Hormuz/shutdown) and higher Brent — strong bullish supply-shock narrative for crude. High direction and relevance as it reflects a market-wide risk premium on oil.

Commodities.title: Wall St futures muted as US-Iran impasse lifts oil prices
Commodities.reason: Wire note linking geopolitical impasse to higher oil prices — supportive for crude and commodity risk premium; representative market-confirmation item.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Three-Day Gain as Trump Demands Cloud Hormuz Outlook
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg coverage pointing to multi-day gains amid Hormuz uncertainty — reinforces the bullish geopolitical/supply-tightness oil narrative.

Commodities.title: Oil in U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve falls below 300 million barrels, lowest since 1983
Commodities.summary: U.S. presidents have increasingly ordered massive releases from the SPR in recent years.
Commodities.reason: SPR inventories below 300m barrels point to structurally slimmer US emergency stocks — a bullish structural factor for oil prices and tighter supply expectations.

Commodities.title: China’s Teapots May Boost Iran Oil Buying as Stockpiles Dwindle
Commodities.reason: Potential incremental demand from Chinese independent refiners lifting Iranian crude purchases supports oil prices amid tighter available seaborne flows.

Commodities.title: Indonesia Copper Shipments Delayed by Gresik Smelter Outage
Commodities.reason: Smelter outage delays shipments — direct supply disruption for copper, bullish for LME/physical spreads and copper prices.

Commodities.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
Commodities.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased sl
Commodities.reason: EIA note indicating increased natural gas trade value between US and Canada — modestly positive signal for natural gas flows/demand; limited immediate price impact.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC sets meeting to propose Reg Crypto to support certain digital assets offerings
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity from the SEC around a formal 'Reg Crypto' framework is broadly positive for institutional issuance and market access — likely to boost issuance, fundraising and investor confidence across digital assets.

Crypto.title: A $2 trillion asset class is getting a new blockchain rail
Crypto.reason: Major new settlement/infrastructure rail for a large asset class materially raises tokenization and institutional use-case adoption — strong positive for crypto infrastructure and long-term flows.

Crypto.title: BTCPay offers $190,000 bounty after bitcoin payment servers drained in exploit
Crypto.reason: A security exploit on Bitcoin payment servers undermines trust in on‑chain/payment rails; bounty shows remediation efforts but event is a modest negative for payments adoption and near‑term sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 fork is 300 blocks behind BTC and six years from fixing itself
Crypto.reason: Technical chain/fork divergence raises protocol governance and replay/continuity questions for Bitcoin — limited market impact now but a structural risk if unresolved.

Crypto.title: XRP, ether lead crypto losses as traders eye $70,000 bitcoin next
Crypto.reason: Near‑term risk sentiment: altcoins and ETH weakness alongside BTC price action implies a risk-off leg and profit-taking — negative for short‑term crypto market performance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's 'strongest hands' are back, on-chain data show
Crypto.reason: On‑chain accumulation by long‑term holders supports a constructive BTC narrative and reduces tail‑risk from weak investor selling — modestly positive for BTC price resilience.

Crypto.title: A rare CME shift: Hedge funds abandon structural shorts to bet on a bitcoin rally
Crypto.reason: Institutional flow change — hedge funds reducing structural shorts and positioning for a rally is a meaningful demand-side impulse that can amplify price appreciation and volatility.

Crypto.title: Strategy sells 1,690 bitcoin, raises $653 million from MSTR shares
Crypto.reason: Significant on‑chain/ETF/strategy selling of BTC from a large holder represents near‑term supply pressure and negative flow into the market.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange Coinsbuy loses $8 million in coordinated two-blockchain attack
Crypto.reason: Exchange security breach and multi‑chain exploit harms user trust and raises counterparty risk — negative for exchange volumes and sentiment until remediation is clear.

Crypto.title: Inside stablecoin firm BVNK’s journey to a $1.8B acquisition by Mastercard
Crypto.reason: Large strategic acquisition by a major payment network signals mainstream financial integration of stablecoins and payments rails — positive for institutional adoption and stablecoin credibility.

Crypto.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
Crypto.reason: Pullback in altcoin ETF ambitions from a major issuer reduces near‑term institutional pathways for non‑bitcoin/ether tokens and reinforces concentration toward BTC/ETH — modestly negative for altcoin demand.
